steps.name: Environment: verify packages, ensure postgres server binaries available, create env templates
steps.description: Validate required server and client binaries (postgres, initdb, pg_ctl, psql, pg_isready, pg_dump, pg_restore). If missing and apt + sudo are available, attempt non-interactive apt-get install of minimal packages. Write a non-secret workspace env template and a non-executable informational /etc/profile.d template. Operates in the workspace path and fails fast with clear remediation instructions if install isn't permitted.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/github-insights-dashboard-42879/postgresql_database"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "sudo not found" >&2; exit 2; }
need_bins=(postgres initdb pg_ctl psql pg_isready pg_dump pg_restore)
missing=()
for b in "${need_bins[@]}"; do command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$b"); done
if [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
    sudo apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -yq --no-install-recommends postgresql postgresql-client ca-certificates procps >/dev/null
    missing=()
    for b in "${need_bins[@]}"; do command -v "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || missing+=("$b"); done
    [ ${#missing[@]} -gt 0 ] && { echo "Missing after install: ${missing[*]}. Manual remediation required: sudo apt-get install postgresql postgresql-client" >&2; exit 4; }
  else
    echo "Missing binaries: ${missing[*]}. Cannot install automatically (apt or sudo unavailable). Run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-client" >&2
    exit 3
  fi
fi
for b in postgres initdb pg_ctl psql pg_isready pg_dump pg_restore; do p=$(command -v "$b" || true); [ -n "$p" ] && printf "%s -> %s\n" "$b" "$p" || printf "%s -> MISSING\n" "$b"; done
postgres --version 2>/dev/null || true
psql --version 2>/dev/null || true
cat > "$WORKSPACE/postgres_env.template" <<'EOF'
# Template (workspace): non-secret defaults for development
POSTGRES_USER="devuser"
POSTGRES_DB="devdb"
# Do NOT store POSTGRES_PASSWORD here; use env or /run/secrets/pg_password
SECRET_KEY="dev-secret-key"
EOF
chmod 0644 "$WORKSPACE/postgres_env.template"
SYSTEM_TMPL="/etc/profile.d/postgres_dev.sh.tmpl"
if ! sudo test -f "$SYSTEM_TMPL" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo tee "$SYSTEM_TMPL" >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Informational template for operators. Do NOT store secrets here.
POSTGRES_USER=devuser
POSTGRES_DB=devdb
EOF
  sudo chmod 0644 "$SYSTEM_TMPL"
fi
exit 0

steps.name: Scaffold: prepare DATA_DIR, configs and helper scripts
steps.description: Create DATA_DIR (/var/lib/postgresql/data) with postgres ownership, write container-friendly postgresql.conf and pg_hba.conf partials into the workspace, and generate helper scripts: init_start_postgres.sh (execs postgres in foreground), pg_healthcheck.sh, pg_backup.sh and pg_restore.sh. Uses secure mktemp and trap cleanup for temp credential files. Operates under the workspace path.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/github-insights-dashboard-42879/postgresql_database"
DATA_DIR="/var/lib/postgresql/data"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && cd "$WORKSPACE"
PG_BIN_POSTGRES=$(command -v postgres || true)
PG_BIN_INITDB=$(command -v initdb || true)
PG_BIN_PGCTL=$(command -v pg_ctl || true)
PG_BIN_PSQL=$(command -v psql || true)
PG_BIN_PGDUMP=$(command -v pg_dump || true)
PG_BIN_PGRESTORE=$(command -v pg_restore || true)
[ -n "$PG_BIN_POSTGRES" ] || { echo "postgres binary missing; run env-setup-001" >&2; exit 5; }
sudo mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR" && sudo chown -R postgres:postgres "$DATA_DIR" && sudo chmod 700 "$DATA_DIR"
cat > "$WORKSPACE/postgresql.conf.partial" <<'EOF'
# Container-friendly settings
listen_addresses = '127.0.0.1'
port = 5432
max_connections = 100
shared_buffers = 128MB
log_destination = 'stderr'
logging_collector = off
EOF
cat > "$WORKSPACE/pg_hba.conf.partial" <<'EOF'
# TYPE  DATABASE        USER            ADDRESS                 METHOD
local   all             all                                     peer
host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            md5
host    all             all             ::1/128                 md5
EOF
chmod 0644 "$WORKSPACE/postgresql.conf.partial" "$WORKSPACE/pg_hba.conf.partial"
# init_start_postgres.sh (idempotent init + foreground exec)
cat > "$WORKSPACE/init_start_postgres.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE}"
DATA_DIR="${DATA_DIR}"
POSTGRES_USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}"
POSTGRES_DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}"
POSTGRES_PASSWORD="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}"
[ -z "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" ] && [ -r /run/secrets/pg_password ] && POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$(cat /run/secrets/pg_password)
POSTGRES_BIN=$(command -v postgres)
INITDB_BIN=$(command -v initdb)
PG_CTL_BIN=$(command -v pg_ctl)
PSQL_BIN=$(command -v psql)
[ -n "$POSTGRES_BIN" ] || { echo "postgres not found" >&2; exit 2; }
sudo mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR" && sudo chown -R postgres:postgres "$DATA_DIR" && sudo chmod 700 "$DATA_DIR"
if sudo -u postgres test -f "$DATA_DIR/PG_VERSION"; then
  exec sudo -u postgres env PATH="$PATH" "$POSTGRES_BIN" -D "$DATA_DIR" -c config_file="$DATA_DIR/postgresql.conf"
fi
TMPPW=$(mktemp -p /tmp pgpw.XXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$TMPPW"' EXIT INT TERM
if [ -n "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" ]; then printf '%s' "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" > "$TMPPW"; chmod 600 "$TMPPW"; fi
if [ -n "$INITDB_BIN" ]; then
  if [ -n "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" ]; then sudo -u postgres "$INITDB_BIN" -D "$DATA_DIR" --encoding=UTF8 --pwfile="$TMPPW"; else sudo -u postgres "$INITDB_BIN" -D "$DATA_DIR" --encoding=UTF8; fi
else
  echo "initdb missing" >&2; exit 3
fi
sudo cp -f "$WORKSPACE/postgresql.conf.partial" "$DATA_DIR/postgresql.conf"
sudo cp -f "$WORKSPACE/pg_hba.conf.partial" "$DATA_DIR/pg_hba.conf"
sudo chown postgres:postgres "$DATA_DIR/postgresql.conf" "$DATA_DIR/pg_hba.conf"
# start temporarily to create role/db
sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL_BIN" -D "$DATA_DIR" -w start -o "-c config_file='$DATA_DIR/postgresql.conf'"
if [ -n "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" ]; then
  PGPASSF=$(mktemp -p /tmp pgpass.XXXX); trap 'rm -f "$TMPPW" "$PGPASSF"' EXIT INT TERM
  printf '127.0.0.1:5432:%s:%s:%s\n' "$POSTGRES_DB" "$POSTGRES_USER" "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" > "$PGPASSF"; chmod 600 "$PGPASSF"; sudo chown postgres:postgres "$PGPASSF"
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" "$PSQL_BIN" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -c "CREATE ROLE \"$POSTGRES_USER\" WITH LOGIN SUPERUSER CREATEDB;" || true
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" "$PSQL_BIN" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -c "ALTER ROLE \"$POSTGRES_USER\" WITH PASSWORD '$POSTGRES_PASSWORD';" || true
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" "$PSQL_BIN" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$POSTGRES_DB\" OWNER \"$POSTGRES_USER\";" || true
  rm -f "$PGPASSF"
else
  sudo -u postgres "$PSQL_BIN" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -c "CREATE ROLE \"$POSTGRES_USER\" WITH LOGIN SUPERUSER CREATEDB;" || true
  sudo -u postgres "$PSQL_BIN" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE \"$POSTGRES_DB\" OWNER \"$POSTGRES_USER\";" || true
fi
sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL_BIN" -D "$DATA_DIR" -m fast -w stop
exec sudo -u postgres env PATH="$PATH" "$POSTGRES_BIN" -D "$DATA_DIR" -c config_file="$DATA_DIR/postgresql.conf"
EOF
chmod 0755 "$WORKSPACE/init_start_postgres.sh" || true
cat > "$WORKSPACE/pg_healthcheck.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
command -v pg_isready >/dev/null || { echo "pg_isready not found" >&2; exit 2; }
PGHOST="${PGHOST:-127.0.0.1}"
PGPORT="${PGPORT:-5432}"
pg_isready -q -h "$PGHOST" -p "$PGPORT" && exit 0 || { echo "pg_isready: not ready" >&2; exit 1; }
EOF
chmod 0755 "$WORKSPACE/pg_healthcheck.sh" || true
cat > "$WORKSPACE/pg_backup.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
OUT="${1:-/tmp/pg_backup.dump}"
PGUSER="${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}"
PGDB="${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}"
PGPASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}"
[ -z "$PGPASS" ] && [ -r /run/secrets/pg_password ] && PGPASS=$(cat /run/secrets/pg_password)
if [ -n "$PGPASS" ]; then
  PGPASSF=$(mktemp -p /tmp pgpass.XXXX); trap 'rm -f "$PGPASSF"' EXIT INT TERM
  printf '127.0.0.1:5432:%s:%s:%s\n' "$PGDB" "$PGUSER" "$PGPASS" > "$PGPASSF"; chmod 600 "$PGPASSF"; sudo chown postgres:postgres "$PGPASSF"
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" pg_dump -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$PGUSER" -Fc "$PGDB" -f "$OUT"
  rm -f "$PGPASSF"
else
  sudo -u postgres pg_dump -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$PGUSER" -Fc "$PGDB" -f "$OUT"
fi
EOF
cat > "$WORKSPACE/pg_restore.sh" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
INFILE="${1:-/tmp/pg_backup.dump}"
PGUSER="${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}"
PGDB="${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}"
PGPASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}"
[ -z "$PGPASS" ] && [ -r /run/secrets/pg_password ] && PGPASS=$(cat /run/secrets/pg_password)
if [ -n "$PGPASS" ]; then
  PGPASSF=$(mktemp -p /tmp pgpass.XXXX); trap 'rm -f "$PGPASSF"' EXIT INT TERM
  printf '127.0.0.1:5432:%s:%s:%s\n' "$PGDB" "$PGUSER" "$PGPASS" > "$PGPASSF"; chmod 600 "$PGPASSF"; sudo chown postgres:postgres "$PGPASSF"
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" pg_restore -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDB" --clean --if-exists "$INFILE"
  rm -f "$PGPASSF"
else
  sudo -u postgres pg_restore -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$PGUSER" -d "$PGDB" --clean --if-exists "$INFILE"
fi
EOF
chmod 0755 "$WORKSPACE/pg_backup.sh" "$WORKSPACE/pg_restore.sh" || true
exit 0

steps.name: Testing: functional DB test (start, query, stop) with chmod fallback
steps.description: Start postgres via pg_ctl if not running, wait for readiness via pg_isready, run a small create/insert/select functional test, then stop the server cleanly. The test runner avoids requiring executable permission on the test script by invoking it via 'bash <script>' when chmod is not permitted. Uses secure temporary files for credentials and cleans up. Depends on env, scaffold, config. Retries enabled.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/github-insights-dashboard-42879/postgresql_database"
DATA_DIR="/var/lib/postgresql/data"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
MAX_WAIT=${MAX_WAIT:-30}
PG_CTL=$(command -v pg_ctl)
PSQL=$(command -v psql)
POSTGRES=$(command -v postgres)
[ -n "$PG_CTL" ] || { echo "pg_ctl missing" >&2; exit 2; }
[ -n "$PSQL" ] || { echo "psql missing" >&2; exit 2; }
# Ensure DB started
if sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL" -D "$DATA_DIR" status >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else
  sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL" -D "$DATA_DIR" -w start -o "-c config_file='$DATA_DIR/postgresql.conf'"
fi
# Wait for readiness
i=0
while [ $i -lt "$MAX_WAIT" ]; do pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || true; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Postgres not ready" >&2; sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL" -D "$DATA_DIR" -m fast -w stop || true; exit 7; }
# Prepare test runner file (idempotent)
TEST_RUNNER="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/.init/test.sh"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TEST_RUNNER")"
cat > "$TEST_RUNNER" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PSQL=$(command -v psql)
DB="${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}"
USER="${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}"
PGPASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}"
[ -z "$PGPASS" ] && [ -r /run/secrets/pg_password ] && PGPASS=$(cat /run/secrets/pg_password)
if [ -n "$PGPASS" ]; then
  PGPASSF=$(mktemp -p /tmp pgpass.XXXX); trap 'rm -f "$PGPASSF"' EXIT INT TERM
  printf '127.0.0.1:5432:%s:%s:%s\n' "$DB" "$USER" "$PGPASS" > "$PGPASSF"; chmod 600 "$PGPASSF"; sudo chown postgres:postgres "$PGPASSF"
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" "$PSQL" -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$USER" -d "$DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dev_health(id serial primary key, msg text);" 
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" "$PSQL" -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$USER" -d "$DB" -c "INSERT INTO dev_health(msg) VALUES('ok');"
  RESULT=$(sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" "$PSQL" -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$USER" -d "$DB" -t -c "SELECT msg FROM dev_health ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  rm -f "$PGPASSF"
else
  sudo -u postgres "$PSQL" -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$USER" -d "$DB" -c "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dev_health(id serial primary key, msg text);"
  sudo -u postgres "$PSQL" -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$USER" -d "$DB" -c "INSERT INTO dev_health(msg) VALUES('ok');"
  RESULT=$(sudo -u postgres "$PSQL" -h 127.0.0.1 -U "$USER" -d "$DB" -t -c "SELECT msg FROM dev_health ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;" | tr -d '[:space:]')
fi
[ "$RESULT" = "ok" ] || { echo "DB functional test failed: $RESULT" >&2; exit 8; }
EOF
chmod 0644 "$TEST_RUNNER" || true
# Try to make it executable; if not permitted, we'll run via bash
if chmod +x "$TEST_RUNNER" 2>/dev/null; then
  RUN_CMD=("bash" "-c" "$TEST_RUNNER")
else
  # chmod failed (likely noexec/readonly mount); fallback to 'bash file'
  if [ -r "$TEST_RUNNER" ]; then
    RUN_CMD=("bash" "$TEST_RUNNER")
  else
    echo "Cannot read test runner $TEST_RUNNER; check permissions" >&2
    sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL" -D "$DATA_DIR" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null || true
    exit 9
  fi
fi
# Execute test runner
"${RUN_CMD[@]}"
# Stop DB
sudo -u postgres "$PG_CTL" -D "$DATA_DIR" -m fast -w stop >/dev/null || true
echo "DB functional test passed"
exit 0

steps.description: Start postgres in foreground using init_start_postgres.sh (exec), wait for readiness via pg_isready, run pg_dump to /tmp as evidence, then terminate server cleanly. Uses secure credential handling and trap-based cleanup for temp files. Depends on all prior setup steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/github-insights-dashboard-42879/postgresql_database"
DATA_DIR="/var/lib/postgresql/data"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
MAX_WAIT=${MAX_WAIT:-30}
# Launch init_start_postgres.sh under postgres user in background (foreground DB process inside)
sudo -u postgres bash -c "exec '$WORKSPACE/init_start_postgres.sh'" &
PG_PID=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
# wait for readiness
i=0
while [ $i -lt "$MAX_WAIT" ]; do pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || true; sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done
pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Validation: postgres not ready within ${MAX_WAIT}s" >&2; kill -TERM "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 9; }
PGPASS="${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-}"
[ -z "$PGPASS" ] && [ -r /run/secrets/pg_password ] && PGPASS=$(cat /run/secrets/pg_password)
OUTFILE="/tmp/validation_pg_dump_$(date +%s).dump"
if [ -n "$PGPASS" ]; then
  PGPASSF=$(mktemp -p /tmp pgpass.XXXX); trap 'rm -f "$PGPASSF"; kill -TERM "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
  printf '127.0.0.1:5432:%s:%s:%s\n' "${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}" "${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}" "$PGPASS" > "$PGPASSF"; chmod 600 "$PGPASSF"; sudo chown postgres:postgres "$PGPASSF"
  sudo -u postgres env PGPASSFILE="$PGPASSF" pg_dump -h 127.0.0.1 -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}" -Fc "${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}" -f "$OUTFILE"
  rm -f "$PGPASSF"
else
  sudo -u postgres pg_dump -h 127.0.0.1 -U "${POSTGRES_USER:-devuser}" -Fc "${POSTGRES_DB:-devdb}" -f "$OUTFILE"
fi
[ -s "$OUTFILE" ] || { echo "Validation: dump failed" >&2; kill -TERM "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; exit 10; }
echo "Validation: dump created at $OUTFILE"
kill -TERM "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$PG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Validation: stopped postgres cleanly"
exit 0
